expected_metrics.aesthetic_cooldown_rate: = 100% on fixture set (at most one expressive reaction per budget window)

description: Two high-novelty visual events occur within 20 seconds. The speak policy must emit at most one aesthetic_reaction (the first), and block the second with silence because the per-mode rate limit (aesthetic_reaction_budget) is exhausted. In normal mode the budget is 1 per 60 min; in walking_outdoor mode it is 1 per 20 min. This fixture uses normal mode. After the first reaction fires, the cooldown blocks the second candidate.

fixture_conventions.skeleton_note: Per-frame signal values are placeholders. Finalize at Stage 3 activation when the aesthetic_reaction_budget config and cooldown timer are specified.
fixture_conventions.task_mode: normal — aesthetic_reaction_budget is 1 per 60 min per spec Part 6 Stage 3.
fixture_conventions.novelty_score: Scripted visual novelty [0.0, 1.0]. Both events are high enough to qualify.
fixture_conventions.cooldown_remaining_ms: Scripted cooldown timer value at each candidate frame. 0 at first event (budget available); > 0 at second event (budget exhausted).
fixture_conventions.expected_action_class_event1: aesthetic_reaction — first candidate fires; budget consumed.
fixture_conventions.expected_action_class_event2: silence — cooldown active; second candidate blocked.
fixture_conventions.inter_event_gap_ms: < 20000 — both events within 20s to stress the rate limit.
fixture_conventions.frame_duration_ms: 33 — approximate 30fps; to be confirmed at Stage 3 activation.
fixture_conventions.expected_events_markers: event_type strings are fixture-internal role labels, not Part 5 event_type values.
